title: The Nine Node Pillars: Enterprise Node.js Best Practices
summary: Nine pillars for enterprise Node.js: event-loop management, LTS versioning, dependency management, and monitoring practices from Cloudflare, Azure, and Red Hat engineers.
when-to-read: Read when architecting, reviewing, or hardening a Node.js application for production, especially around event-loop behavior, dependency hygiene, or monitoring. Do not read for general JavaScript language or frontend guidance — this is backend/runtime operational practice, not a language tutorial.
